why_selected: Dense 18-key panel of abbreviations and 0/1 codes (er, pr, her2, til, time.os/event.os); pools with GSE58984 on ER/PR/age/tumour size
Spelled-out keys (er status, pgr status, nodes positive, time to ddfs); same concepts as GSE237290 under different names and encodings
Code legend inside a key ("n-stage (0, neg; 1, pos)"), unit in a key ("rfs (years)"), pcr; pools pcr with GSE149322
Ambiguous abbreviation "hr" (hormone receptor), pcr coded 0/1/-1, treatment arm
Sparse and abbreviated (mort30, shock); pools shock with GSE119217
diagnosis, outcome, time of sample collection; pools outcome with GSE272769 mort30
Patient IDs, T1-T3 time points, coded SS/CS classes, Sex present for only 10/106 samples, re-analysis samples
11 keys incl. patient_age vs sample_age(y), disease_duration (y), nancy_score, inflammation_status
uc or healthy control (key names a contrast), mayoscore, diagnose duration (years)
mayo score vs GSE206171 mayoscore, visit, wk6response, treatment
Only one characteristic (tissue); subject, inflammation status and week live in sample titles - tests title extraction
Legend and unit inside keys ("donor gender (m=male; f=female)", "donor bmi (bmi kg/m2)", "donor age (yrs)")
hba1c (mmol/mol) - same variable as GSE231509 "hba1c, %" in a different unit
Units after commas ("fasting glucose,_mm", "fasting insulin,_miu/l", "hba1c, %"), homa ir

Two sub-cohorts with different conventions in one series: age (yr) vs age, bmi (kg/m2) vs bmi with unit in value, two variables in one cell ("Glucose (AC): 158 mg/dL; HbA1C: 10%"), typo duplicate keys, ranges ("Between 4.0% and 5.6%")
